paragraphs: CaseGuard sells AI redaction software that runs automated redaction workflows for law enforcement, legal teams, and other buyers. The software blurs faces, license plates, and screens in footage from body-worn cameras, CCTV, and dash cams. It also searches for and redacts PII across PDF files, emails, and legal documents.

Transcription identifies speakers, detects PII and PHI, and feeds translation into more than 100 languages. CaseGuard runs locally on customer machines, including air-gapped networks with no internet connection.

The company dates the work to 2014 and says founder Sean Abas has spent 20 years in AI and privacy. Clients span government, law enforcement, legal, healthcare, finance, education, and transportation. Customers quoted on the site include the University of Arizona Police Department.

quote.text: Redaction software built for speed, precision, and trust.
